title: Responsive waffle unit chart
intent: Show a one-hundred-unit composition where every cell represents one percentage point.

ai.create: Create a responsive one-hundred-unit waffle chart from typed category totals, using Plot's native waffle mark or an explicit TanStack cell grid with a stable category color scale.
ai.maintain: Change category totals while preserving a total of one hundred units, one stable key per unit, responsive near-square cells, and consistent category colors.
